trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum needs no task of its own: it pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all on your account. Build the whole run around the long grinds — the story, the 100% checklist and the collectible sweeps — and leave this one for last. One rule for the entire playthrough: never use cheats, because a single cheat disables trophy earning and saving.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission that introduces Jason, Lucia and the Leonida coast. It is unmissable and mostly a tutorial: follow the prompts, learn the basics of moving, driving and shooting, and the trophy lands as the mission closes. On a fresh save this is the first trophy of the run.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through every mission of Chapter 1; the trophy pops at the chapter's closing cutscene and cannot be skipped. Before you leave the chapter behind, do the meditation offered at Jason's house — Positive Mental Attitude has the list's only missable step there, and with no mission replay there is no returning for it later.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2, where the pair's money problems turn into their first real scores. Finishing the chapter is mandatory for progress, so the trophy itself cannot be missed; the discipline that matters is keeping a manual save at the chapter break, because the game has no mission replay and any one-off feat inside a mission must be done while you are in it.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3; the trophy arrives automatically at the end of the chapter's last mission. The map opens up here, so start the habits that pay off later: scan new vehicles for Whip It Good, tag WAiNK spots as you pass them, and try each new activity type once toward Master of None instead of leaving them all for the clean-up.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the endgame. Put a manual save at the chapter boundary before starting the final stretch. Free-roam continues after the credits, so nothing else on the list is locked away by finishing — the save is simply insurance for the finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission to earn this gold. Winning it also unlocks the state the platinum run depends on: free-roam continues, and the 100% Completion checklist becomes viewable (Touch Pad > Progress > Stats), so every remaining trophy can be cleaned up at your own pace. Clear any mission-specific feats before starting the finale, because there is no mission replay.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a fixed campaign beat, so it unlocks simply by playing the story in order: start the mission when its marker appears in the early chapters and see it through. No medal, optional objective or side condition is attached to this one.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a scripted campaign set-piece. Play it when it unlocks and the trophy pops on completion — nothing optional is tracked. Keep it separate in your mind from the free-roam robbery trophies (Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play), which are different feats you can attempt at any time.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission bronzes it is earned by ordinary campaign progress, with no optional objective or medal required. Following the roadmap, it arrives during your Stage 1 story playthrough.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Start it when it appears in the campaign and finish it; the trophy is awarded automatically at the mission's end. Nothing beyond finishing the mission itself is required.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, the story mission set around Vice City International Airport. Finishing it earns the bronze, and the mission doubles as a tour of the airfield — knowing that layout makes Catch Me If You Can, the unscheduled-departure trophy at the same airport, much easier afterwards.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. A plain campaign-completion bronze: play the mission through when it appears and it pops at the end. Keep your manual saves at the chapter boundaries and trophies like this one never need a second thought.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist. The checklist only becomes viewable after the story (Touch Pad > Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), although everything you do during the story already counts toward it. It asks for roughly 60% of everything in the game — story, robberies, gang operations, bank vaults, ranges, races, part of the collectibles and 70 of the 80 challenges — so work it methodically after the credits and expect this gold to be among the last trophies you earn.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — the stunt jumps and set-piece leaps scattered across Leonida. There are 397 in total, so you need a little over half. Found stunts show on the map (Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots) and your running tally sits under Progress > Activities > Stunts. Clear them region by region during the Stage 2 and 3 sweeps instead of grinding them in one sitting.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's 9 activity types once — races, shooting ranges, drone races, fishing, arcade games, meditation and Leonida's other pastimes. You do not need to win or score; a single attempt registers the type. Most are introduced during the story, so late in Stage 1 check your Progress screen and deliberately sample whatever is still greyed out.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Ranges unlock as you explore, and gold demands accuracy and speed together, so learn each challenge at a lower medal first, then push for gold with the weapon you handle best. Track which ranges still owe you a gold under Progress > Activities — they also count toward the 100% checklist, so Stage 3 is the natural home for them.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. A finish is not enough — you must come first — so learn each course's line with a practice run, then race it clean; smooth cornering beats full throttle on the straights. The locations span the whole map, so fold them into your exploration sweep and tick them off region by region.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeat wins on the same track do not add to the count — 'different' is the requirement — so move between the map's race series (street, off-road, water and air) and take one win in each. Any vehicle class counts as long as you cross the line first; if a race keeps beating you, return later with a faster, upgraded ride.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at his fishing spot, accept the challenge and land the better catch under the rules he sets. If he keeps out-fishing you, work through the fishing progression first to improve your tackle — the challenge can be retried as often as you like, so treat the early attempts as practice.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Cabinets sit in arcades and bars around Leonida: walk up to one, play, and finish a full game — win or lose, completion is what counts. Most players earn this in passing while sampling activity types for Master of None.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's character strand. His missions appear as optional markers during and after the story; work the strand through in order and the trophy pops when his last job is done. Character strands also feed the Strangers & Freaks count, so they are worth prioritising in Stage 3.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's strand. Follow his optional mission markers whenever they appear and finish the chain; the trophy is awarded at the end of his final mission. Strands stay available in free-roam after the story, so this can be cleaned up in Stage 3 if you passed it by earlier.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's strand. His jobs are optional character missions: accept each one as it is offered, finish the chain, and the trophy pops at the end of his last mission. Doing the character strands as they appear keeps Stage 3 short.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. A strand is a chain: starting a stranger's missions is not enough — you must see 8 different strands through to their final missions, and the Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone chains all count toward it. Stranger markers appear as you explore, so keep a note of the strands you have started and finish what you begin.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's strand. Randy's jobs revolve around moving product: accept each mission as it appears, finish the chain, and the trophy pops at the end of his final job. Like the other character strands, it remains available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's strand. Work through his optional missions in order; the trophy is awarded when his last mission ends. Finish all five named character strands and you will also be most of the way to Strangers & Freaks.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — and mind the one missable step on the whole list. The Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house, the balcony meditation with Lucia, can be skipped as you play, and with no mission replay there is no way back for it in that playthrough; PowerPyx, KeenGamer and GTABase all flag it. Do that meditation the moment it is offered, keep a manual save at each chapter break, and collect the other 17 spots at leisure — they stay available in free-roam.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. His strand is the hunting line: take his missions, study animals through the binoculars to learn their habits (studying wildlife also feeds the 100% checklist), and track the one unique specimen he names. When the hunt is offered, follow it through in the same session so the trail does not go cold.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards hide across Leonida — in shops, bars, landmarks and out-of-the-way corners — and a set completes when every card in it is collected. There are 15 completable sets in the game, so you need only a fifth of them: focus on the three sets whose cards cluster in regions you sweep early, and use the collection screen to see which sets are nearly done.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-world app for tagging and scanning the world — vehicles, animals and marked locations — and using it at 100 distinct locations builds this count. Make it a habit from the first hour: tag something in every new district you enter and the trophy lands naturally during exploration, while the vehicle scans also feed Whip It Good and the 100% checklist.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's skill tests — the full set numbers 80, of which the 100% checklist wants 70 — so this trophy's bar of 50 is the friendlier one. Pick tests that suit your play style across driving, shooting, stunt and exploration categories, and skip the hardest few. Your count is tracked under Progress, so check it during Stage 3 and target the categories where you are already closest.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you, and escape the heat completely. Raise trouble together until the wanted level reaches four stars, then break line of sight and hide — swap vehicles, go off-road or duck into cover — until the search ends. Both conditions matter: your partner must be present and the escape must finish, so do not split up mid-chase.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without your Wanted Level fully clearing at any point. Plan a route of three shops close together, rob the first, and move straight to the next while the heat is still on — if the wanted level clears between shops, the chain resets. A fast car waiting outside each shop and your partner covering the door make this far easier.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts when you get into it or scan it with the WAiNK app, and Leonida's roads are full of variety, so vary your driving: scan new models whenever one catches your eye instead of living in a single favourite car. The 100% checklist ultimately wants 200 of the game's 277 base models scanned, so this trophy is only the halfway point of that habit.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus, the leads' slow-motion aiming ability. Charge the meter, then trigger it in a crowded firefight — a gang operation or a busy story shootout — and drop five targets before the effect ends; headshots conserve the meter. If a fight is too sparse, let enemies group up before activating it. Failed attempts cost nothing, so retry on the next big fight.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — in plain terms, take off from Vice City International Airport in a plane you were never cleared to fly. Take an aircraft on the airfield (expect a wanted level for it), get it airborne, and the trophy pops as you leave the airport behind. The story mission VCIA Takedown teaches you the layout; attempting this in free-roam afterwards keeps it repeatable whenever you need another try.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — points at the Rhino, the game's tank, and this is one of the list's deliberately cryptic hidden trophies. Get into a Rhino when heavy military heat brings armour out (a maximum wanted level draws the strongest response) and spend time operating it under fire. The published lists agree on the wording but the precise trigger is a community-confirmed detail, so if simply driving one does not pop it, stay in the tank through a full wanted-level escape and try again.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Scope the store first, go in quietly — no weapon drawn on the door, no alarms tripped — take the goods and walk out before anyone raises the alert; being spotted mid-robbery voids the attempt. If one store's layout keeps exposing you, pick a quieter one and try at night. The trophy only needs one clean job.

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vault jobs are the heavy end of the robbery ladder: case the bank, bring your partner and a fast getaway car, crack the vault, and lose the heat afterwards — a robbery you are caught during does not count. Eight vault robberies feature in the 100% requirements, so five clean escapes also move A Long Road forward.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes around Leonida: stop one by blocking or disabling it, crack the rear doors, take the cash and break away before the response pins you down. The escape is part of the requirement — the trophy pops once you have lost the heat with the money in hand.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every one of its 52 areas. An area registers when you first set foot in it, so this is a pure exploration sweep: ride every highway, island and backwater on the map until no region is unvisited. Do it alongside the Stage 2 collectible sweeps — meditations, cards and WAiNK spots will drag you into most corners anyway — then scan the map for any district you somehow never touched.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — one operation for each of Leonida's 9 gangs, rather than farming the same gang nine times. Every gang runs operations on its own turf, so work the map gang by gang and keep a note of which ones you have already hit. Gang operations also feed the 100% checklist (39 operations in total), so none of the trips are wasted.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the Ocean Beach strip, order a cocktail at a beachfront bar, and drink it where the description asks — with the ocean in front of you. It is a quiet moment with nothing missable attached: if it does not pop at the first bar, try another beachfront spot along the same strip.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Get into a car inside a showroom and drive it out through the glass frontage rather than through the door — the 'classic style' the description winks at. Any showroom with a display car and a glass front works; expect a wanted level for the exit.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Find the alley, start a game of bowling there and play it through to the end — the trophy's wording riffs on the series' old bowling pastime, and the requirement is simply to bowl at the named alley. It also counts as one of the activity types sampled for Master of None if you have not bowled yet.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — is one of the list's riddles: it points to a shared moment between the two leads performed in front of an audience. Play the partner content in public places — races, robberies and events in crowded spots with both leads together — and it pops from the qualifying moment. The published lists carry the same wording without one confirmed trigger, so treat this as an earn-it-by-playing trophy rather than a checklist step.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: A counter trophy: PlayStation tracks your in-game choices toward a total of 500, so it fills in as you make decisions across the story and free-roam — dialogue picks, mercy-or-mayhem moments and other either/or calls. There is nothing to farm in a single spot; if it is still outstanding late in Stage 3, keep playing content that presents choices and it will complete on its own.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: succeed at something on your second attempt, right after failing it once. The natural way to earn it is organic — fail a race, a challenge or a robbery approach, immediately retry it, and succeed. If you are cleaning up deliberately, pick a short race, lose it on purpose, then win the retry.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. This is the list's Easter-egg bronze: Leonida hides odd encounters off the beaten path — strange lights and stranger-than-usual strangers, mostly at night and away from the city. The published lists keep the wording deliberately vague because the trigger is a discovery, so explore rural Leonida after dark during your Stage 2 sweeps and investigate anything that looks out of place.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving slowly past a pedestrian or rival, use your melee attack so the swing knocks them down like a bowling pin — the melee contact is what the trophy asks for, so aim for a clean sideswipe rather than a full-speed run-over. A crowded sidewalk at low speed gives you plenty of attempts.

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies; instead of spending them raw, pass them to your laundering contacts, who return clean money for a cut. The counter is cumulative earnings through laundering, so route every marked payout through your contacts from mid-game on and the total builds quickly alongside the robbery trophies.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Cumulative spending anywhere — clothes, weapons, vehicles, services — counts toward the total, so this usually pops on its own during a full playthrough. If you are short late in the run, Leonida's luxury shops will happily take the rest; there is no need to spend it all in one place or in one session.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought from property listings as they unlock across the story; you need the cash, and for some of them the story progress, before they are offered. Buy each one as it appears rather than saving for a spree — owning garages also gives you storage for the vehicles behind Whip It Good and On the Spot.

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you find a vehicle worth keeping, use the app to register it; ten registrations is a small ask once you are already scanning and discovering vehicles for Whip It Good. Register distinct vehicles as you encounter them — the garages from Little Boxes give you somewhere to keep them all.
